verdict.rationale: Highnote supports rule-based automation scoped to payment events: spend rules and velocity controls automatically permit/restrict authorizations based on MCC, amount, count, and time windows, and collaborative authorization triggers real-time approve/decline logic; webhooks notify on configurable events for downstream action. This is genuine event-triggered automation but is narrowly scoped to payment authorization/transaction events rather than a general-purpose rule engine for arbitrary triggers/actions. Missing for 10: evidence of a broader condition-action rule builder spanning non-payment events, and confirmation that webhook-triggered actions (not just notifications) can be configured natively rather than requiring external orchestration.
